main_text.p: & 14. Scriptura dicit, Ethnicos foluos invocare idola, & eis commendare falutem suam: nemo autem invocat aut orat fimulacrum, inquit Augustinus in Pfal. 113. qui non putet ab illo fe exaudiri. Qua probatione fi conclufum velit Ethnicos putasse idola ipsa' esse Deos: concludet Pontificios pari ratione putare fimulacra fua Deos esse. Nam quum ad imaginem Sancti alicuius pronuntiant orationem Dominicam; quod teste a Tra&.de o-rat.tit. Quis orandus sit.Catechismo Tridentino faciunt: dicunt ligno, aut lapidi, Pater noster es. Nec enim, quia phrasi difcrepare videntur, dicere ligno, & dicere ad lignum; idcirco re differre cenfenda funt quæ Ieremias & Catechismus notant. Siquidem, & phrasi, qua Cathechismus utitur, uti item potuit Ieremiæ interpres, ut paffim confuevit, b Gen.6.13. & 7.1. & 9.1.Dixit Dominus ad Noe, ad eum, ad eos: ¹Heb. [illegible, ~4 letters] &[Hebrew, illegible, ~4 letters] vt a-pud Ieremiamc& Bellarminus plane ac perfpicuè morem Pontificiorum oratorum explicans, Concionatores, inquit, alloquuntur imaginem crucifixi, eíque dicunt, tu nos redemisti, tu nos Patri reconciliasti. Videlicet quemadmodum Bellarminus addit, ifta non dici imagini, nec ut lignum eft, nec ut imago eft, fed ut accipitur loco exemplaris, id eft, dicit ipfi Chrifto, cuius tamen imago vicem gerit: fic e De ecclef. triumph. lib. 2.c.23. [Hebrew, illegible, ~3 letters]d In Pfal.113. concion.2.ex d Augustino apparet Ethnicos haud fuisse profesos fe preces fimulacris fundere quatenus ligna erant, aut quatenus fimulacra, fed ut accipiebantur loco exemplarium, id eft, orasse Deos ipfos, quorum tamen vicem fimulacra gerebant. Quid igitur? An Bellarminus, ut evincat Ethnicos tam fatuos exstitisse, eodem quoque coeno fuos inquinabit?

page.notes: Keys a to e are marked in the text as small letters beside the words where the printed marks stand; the mark "e" has no visible mark in the text, so its position is approximate. Hebrew words in the margin are not legible enough to copy and are marked illegible. Several long-s forms appear as "ff" or "fs" and have been read as plain s. The apostrophe after "ipfa" and the small mark after "Heb." are uncertain. The note "Eodem lib. 2. cap. 13." stands at the head of the left margin and is not placed in the text block. The catchword "Immo" sits at lower right below the last line.
